high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a gym. The individual is wearing a dark blue hoodie with white text and logos on the front. The text on the hoodie includes "University of Sheffield" and "School of Sport, Exercise & Health Sciences." The person has long, dark hair and is holding up a smartphone with a gold case, which has a card or paper partially inserted into it. In the background, there are various gym equipment pieces, such as weight machines and a water dispenser. The gym has a modern design with a tiled floor and a ceiling with recessed lighting.
